Private Audio Mini controller. Status: %1$s. Turn am on, expand, and close controls.

Private Audio no dey collect, record or send your conversation or audio content.

Di app no need account or sign-in. E no dey ask for microphone access and e no dey use analytics, advert or crash-report service. Private Audio no dey ask for Android Internet permission and e no dey send data go server.

Private Audio dey observe only di technical state and metadata of Android audio system as audio routing and diagnostics need am. E no dey access wetin dey inside your conversation.

App settings dey store for your device locally. Diagnostic data dey generated and processed locally, and diagnostic report dey save only when you choose to save am. Report fit contain technical information about your device, Android version, audio routing and audio-system state, but e no contain conversation or audio content.

Android app-data backup dey disabled.
